"[[Robin's Palm Writings: la nicte cadzu]]" is both the title of a story (book, really) entirely in Lojban by [[Robin Lee Powell|Robin Lee Powell]], and the name of the central organization in that story.

Robin tends to make quite a few mistakes, both typographical and grammatical, so there is a [[la nicte cadzu Errata|la nicte cadzu Errata]] page.

Creating LNC tends to involve a lot of vocabulary work, hence the [[lo valsi po la nicte cadzu|lo valsi po la nicte cadzu]] page.
